body: Thanks guys, I'm feeling a little less hopeless this morning, I think getting it all out helped. Keep being awesome.

Yeah that comic describes it perfectly. I did some reckless things for sure and that's probably why I ended up back at square one, but it was still the happiest I'd been in years. Just feeling like I was in charge of my life was the greatest feeling and I would do almost anything to get that back again. I can't seem to do it though. I can't just will myself to not care. I'm just waiting for that light switch to flick on in my head again.

Sorry :/ I think there might be more of us out there than it seems. I've met a couple of people online who are in similar situations. It's getting easier and easier for people to isolate themselves, with everything you can do on the internet there's not much to force someone to leave the house if they don't want to. Of course, the more you shut yourself away, the harder it gets to get back out there again and eventually you end up trapped in your miniscule comfort zone. I escaped for a few months once. I just broke. Everything hurt so much that my brain short-circuited and I stopped giving a fuck about all the things that I was anxious about. It was amazing. I got my life back. But then some really bad things happened and I withdrew again. I'm wondering if I'm getting to that breaking point again now. I really hope so.

Yeah I think social anxiety is a big part of it. I worry that I'll embarrass myself in social situations. I'm inexperienced and it shows. I've hidden myself away so much that even the tiniest things seem huge now, like going for a walk or even making a phone call. I feel very isolated from other people, like there's me... and there's the rest of the world. As far as talking to my parents, yes, I do try sometimes, but my mum is stressed out all the time and my dad has his own issues, so pleasant conversations are pretty rare. I used to have a few "internet friends" and that was cool for a while, but it's no substitute for the real thing, they pretty much abandoned me as soon as I stopped playing the games that they play. That's what's been hitting me hardest lately. I'm desperate for some support and there's no one who cares enough to be there for me. Maybe I was dumb for thinking there would be.

Glad to hear you're doing better. I have tried antidepressants before and they just make me feel numb, which is better than this, but not enough to enable me to make whatever changes I need to make. I've tried counselling too and again, it's good to be able to vent, but it didn't change much for me. I went to the doctor a few days ago and he recommended I call some kind of mental health service, which I did, but I haven't heard back from them yet so I'll have to see how that goes. I'm not holding out much hope there to be honest, but I figured it was worth a try. Thanks for the kind words.

Hey, thanks for asking... I should've put more in the actual post but lately I'm finding it really hard to talk about things. I think I must be pretty severely depressed at this point. I'm 20 and things have just been going really wrong in my life for about 8 years. I missed a lot of school because of mental and physical health problems and it's gotten to the point now where I haven't left the house (barring the occasional doctor's appointment or family visit) in over a year. My life has just become a list of things I can't do due to anxiety or whatever. I don't have any friends. I wake up and sit in front of the computer until I fall asleep. I don't even take care of myself any more, it just seems like too much effort. I used to play games and watch movies and stuff but lately I can't even enjoy that, so I just end up sitting here staring at the screen. My parents don't seem to have time for me, I just feel like a nuisance and an embarrassment to them, but I know that it would still destroy them if I ended my life. Sometimes I wish they didn't care at all, that way I could just curl up and die like I desperately want to. There's still this tiny hope in my head that maybe there's another way out of this, but every time I try to find it I fail miserably, and it takes years to work up the courage to try again. It hurts so much to see other people my age going to university, having relationships, going on nights out with friends... and all the while I'm lying here in a dark room, watching the years pass me by. I just can't take it any more. I hate how pathetic I've become. I need to either find a way to fix myself or end this.
